chart.description: Total no of errors per service by error codes
chart.name: #Error breakdown by code
chart.programText:
A = data('inference_objective_request_error_total', filter=filter('error_code', 'BadRequest'), rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='A')
B = data('inference_objective_request_error_total', filter=filter('error_code', 'ServiceUnavailable')).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='B')
C = data('inference_objective_request_error_total', filter=filter('error_code', 'Internal')).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='C')
